function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, with 48 patients appearing twice (each with `sample_seq` = 1 and 2). This means the dataset has 848 rows but only 800 unique patients.", "implication": "If we compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease without deduplicating, we would be counting some patients twice. Since the `sample_seq` indicates re-testing, and the data dictionary says to keep the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient, we must deduplicate before computing the fraction. Otherwise, we risk double-counting patients who were re-tested."}
function.name: note_finding
